name: S3IM (Stochastic Structural SIMilarity)
definition: A multiplex loss function for neural fields that captures nonlocal structural similarity by processing multiple data points (pixels/rays) as a whole set, rather than individually. It addresses the limitation of point-wise losses (like MSE) which fail to use collective supervision of distant pixels.
summary: S3IM is a regularization term for neural field optimization that enforces global structural consistency by treating random pixel batches as stochastic patches, unlike conventional pixel-wise losses.
